title: Prosthodontics & Crown Restoration
description: Stomatologiya bo'yicha Protezlash va tish qoplamalari mavzusida klinik muloqot va tibbiy ingliz tili darsi.
scenario_prompt: You are a virtual patient presenting with symptoms related to Prosthodontics & Crown Restoration. Speak in natural, everyday patient English.

patient_profile.history: Patient presents with complaints of prosthodontics & crown restoration.

grammar.title: Comparative and Superlative Adjectives in Prosthetic Treatment Planning
grammar.title_uz: Protezlash Variantlarini Solishtirishda Qiyosiy va Orttirma Darajalar
grammar.title_ru: Сравнительная и Превосходная Степень Прилагательных при Протезировании
grammar.title_en: Comparative and Superlative Adjectives in Prosthetic Treatment Planning
grammar.rule_explanation: Use comparatives (more durable than, better than, less invasive than) and superlatives (the most aesthetic, the strongest) to help patients understand differences between implants, bridges, and dentures.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Implant, ko'prik va olinadigan protezlar orasidagi farq, chidamlilik va afzalliklarni solishtirishda 'more + sifat + than' (qiyosiy) hamda 'the most + sifat' (orttirma) darajalari qo'llaniladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравнительные формы (more durable than, better than) и превосходная степень (the most natural) помогают пациенту выбрать вид протезирования.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparative and superlative forms objectively contrast dental implants vs bridges vs removable dentures.
grammar.structure_pattern: [Option A] + is + more [Adjective] than + [Option B] | [Option] + is the most [Adjective]
grammar.structure_pattern_uz: [Variant A] + is + more [Sifat] than + [Variant B] | [Variant] + is the most [Sifat]
grammar.structure_pattern_ru: [Вариант А] + is + more [Прилагательное] than + [Вариант Б] | is the most [Прилагательное]
grammar.structure_pattern_en: [Option A] + is + more [Adjective] than + [Option B] | [Option] + is the most [Adjective]

examples.sentence: Dental implants are significantly more durable and stable than removable partial dentures.
examples.translation_uz: Dental implantlar olinadigan qisman protezlarga qaraganda ancha chidamli va mustahkamdir.
examples.translation_ru: Дентальные имплантаты значительно более долговечны и стабильны, чем съемные протезы.

examples.sentence: All-ceramic zirconia crowns offer the most natural cosmetic appearance in the anterior zone.
examples.translation_uz: To'liq sirkoniy keramik qoplamalar oldingi estetik sohada eng tabiiy chiroyli ko'rinishni ta'minlaydi.
examples.translation_ru: Цельнокерамические коронки из диоксида циркония обеспечивают наиболее естественный эстетический результат.

common_mistakes.incorrect: Implants are more better than dentures.
common_mistakes.correct: Implants are much better than dentures.
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: 'Better' so'zi oldidan 'more' qo'yilmaydi; kuchaytirish uchun 'much better' ishlatiladi.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень 'better' не сочетается с 'more'. Для усиления используют 'much better'.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Never combine 'more' with irregular comparatives like 'better'. Use 'much better'.

phrasebook.hint_en: The root canal treatment was successful, but the remaining structure is heavily compromised. We need to discuss a permanent restorative solution.
phrasebook.patient_response: I'm relieved the infection is gone, but a significant piece broke off. Is a standard composite filling no longer an option?

phrasebook.phrase: Because over 50% of the clinical crown is missing, a simple filling wouldn't withstand normal masticatory forces. I strongly recommend a full-coverage dental crown.
phrasebook.hint: Tish tojining 50% dan ortig'i yo'qolgani sababli, oddiy plomba odatiy chaynash bosimiga bardosh bera olmaydi. To'liq qoplaydigan tish tojini tavsiya qilaman.

phrasebook.hint_en: Because over 50% of the clinical crown is missing, a simple filling wouldn't withstand normal masticatory forces. I strongly recommend a full-coverage dental crown.
phrasebook.patient_response: I see. What materials do you offer for crowns, and how do they differ in terms of durability and appearance?

phrasebook.phrase: Zirconia is exceptionally strong, biocompatible, and provides a seamless match. PFM is durable, but over time, a dark metallic line might become visible near the gumline.
phrasebook.hint: Sirkoniy o'ta mustahkam, biologik mos keluvchi va tish rangiga mos tushadi. Metall-keramika ham chidamli, ammo vaqt o'tishi bilan milk chizig'ida metall ko'rinib qolishi mumkin.
phrasebook.hint_uz: Sirkoniy o'ta mustahkam, biologik mos keluvchi va tish rangiga mos tushadi. Metall-keramika ham chidamli, ammo vaqt o'tishi bilan milk chizig'ida metall ko'rinib qolishi mumkin.

phrasebook.hint_en: Zirconia is exceptionally strong, biocompatible, and provides a seamless match. PFM is durable, but over time, a dark metallic line might become visible near the gumline.
phrasebook.patient_response: That makes sense. I also have a missing tooth right next to it. Can we address both issues together?

phrasebook.phrase: For the gap, we have two options: a dental bridge or a dental implant. A bridge anchors onto adjacent teeth, while an implant acts as an artificial root in the jawbone.
phrasebook.hint: Bo'shliq uchun ikkita variant bor: tish ko'prigi yoki dental implantat. Ko'prik yon atrofdagi tishlarga tayanadi, implantat esa jag' suyagiga o'rnatiladigan sun'iy ildizdir.
phrasebook.hint_uz: Bo'shliq uchun ikkita variant bor: tish ko'prigi yoki dental implantat. Ko'prik yon atrofdagi tishlarga tayanadi, implantat esa jag' suyagiga o'rnatiladigan sun'iy ildizdir.

phrasebook.hint_en: For the gap, we have two options: a dental bridge or a dental implant. A bridge anchors onto adjacent teeth, while an implant acts as an artificial root in the jawbone.
phrasebook.patient_response: Preserving my healthy teeth sounds much better. Is the implant procedure complicated, and how long does osseointegration take?

phrasebook.phrase: It's a standard minor surgical procedure. Osseointegration usually takes about 3 to 4 months. In the meantime, we can fit a Zirconia crown first.
phrasebook.hint: Bu standart kichik jarrohlik muolajasi. Osseointegratsiya suyak bilan birikishi uchun 3-4 oy vaqt oladi. Ungacha esa birinchi bo'lib Sirkoniy koronkasi o'rnatib turamiz.

phrasebook.hint_en: It's a standard minor surgical procedure. Osseointegration usually takes about 3 to 4 months. In the meantime, we can fit a Zirconia crown first.
phrasebook.patient_response: That sounds like a clear plan. Let's proceed with the Zirconia crown today, and schedule a 3D digital scan for the implant planning next week.

tests.question: What is the medical meaning of the term 'root canal treatment' in clinical consultation?
tests.explanation: 'root canal treatment' atamasining to'g'ri ma'nosi: tish kanali davosi.

tests.question: Which term corresponds to 'ko'ngli joyiga tushgan, xotirjam'?
tests.explanation: 'ko'ngli joyiga tushgan, xotirjam' ma'nosiga mos keluvchi tibbiy termin 'relieved' hisoblanadi.

tests.question: Which of the following is the grammatically and clinically standard question to ask about the duration of symptoms?
tests.option_a: How long do you having this symptom?
tests.option_b: How long has this condition been bothering you?
tests.option_c: Since what time you have this problem?
tests.option_d: How many days you are feeling pain?
tests.explanation: Klinik anamnezda davomiylikni so'rash uchun Present Perfect Continuous ('How long has... been bothering you?') to'g'ri shakl hisoblanadi.

tests.question: When evaluating acute pain, what is the best phrasing to assess pain character?
tests.option_a: Is your pain bad or very bad?
tests.option_b: Can you describe the pain—is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
tests.option_c: Why do you have sharp pain today?
tests.explanation: Og'riq xarakterini aniqlashda shifokor ochiq va taklif qiluvchi variantlar (sharp, dull, throbbing, aching) beradi.
